description: List the open, unexpired bounties a grinding worker can race to claim — the queue worker fleets poll. Each entry carries the pattern to grind and the escrowed USDC reward; the first worker to submit a verified, sealed key wins. Read-only discovery; submitting a claim is a separate write on the HTTP API.

limit.description: Max claimable bounties to return (1–100, default 30).

name: vanity_open
title: List claimable open bounties for workers
